title: Repeated C_SC_NA_1 parser-depth pair
purpose: Drive repeated valid decoding of the same command family with different IOA and qualifier bytes to increase field-interaction depth without malformed nesting.
expected_behavior: The target should parse two complete valid single-command APDUs in sequence, traversing the same object path twice with varied address and qualifier values.
constraints_preserved: Both messages are complete CS104 I-format APDUs
Both use documented TypeID 45 for C_SC_NA_1
Both retain VSQ count 1 and non-sequence form
Both include a full 3-byte IOA and one qualifier byte
APDU lengths remain 0x0e for 14 bytes after the length byte
Only field values vary; widths and ordering remain fixed
issue_safety_notes: Stays strictly valid and mutation-friendly, avoiding malformed repetitions, missing bytes, or crash-oriented transport patterns.
